entries.purpose: Legacy Twin 1: Unity robot/navigation twin combining truth world, controller, sensors and decision client in one scene.

entries.reason: Fails conditions 2 and 7: resurrects Twin1.

entries.purpose: Buoyancy, linear+quadratic drag, added mass, restoring torque, attitude safety envelope on a Unity Rigidbody.
entries.architectural_compatibility: Weaker than V2: added mass as force from finite-differenced velocity, control logic (PolicyCommandAuthority01, SafetyRecoveryTorque=180) embedded in physics.
entries.dependency_contamination: Unity Rigidbody, Physics.gravity, Time.fixedDeltaTime; unsourced constants ViscousLinearDrag=(2,3,4), LinearDrag=(18,22,28), AngularDrag=(4,4,6), AddedMass=(5,8,10), DisplacedVolume=0.02, RestoringTorque=25.
entries.test_quality: HydrodynamicsTests.cs: drag opposes motion, zero at rest.
entries.reason: Coefficients invented with no citation or fit; no validated value beyond V2 from-spec model.

entries.purpose: Command-to-thrust curve with dead zone, exponent, reverse ratio, voltage/density/thermal/fouling scaling.
entries.architectural_compatibility: Concept overlaps V2 actuator model; values unusable.
entries.dependency_contamination: Unsourced MaxForceNewtons=50, ThrustCurveExponent=1.65, ReverseThrustRatio=0.82, CommandDeadZone=0.06, ResponseTimeSeconds=0.14, SupplyVoltageV=48, fouling floor 0.55.
entries.test_quality: One EditMode test of curve shape only.
entries.reason: Nominal constants with no datasheet; V2 thruster curves must be sourced or labelled ENGINEERING_ESTIMATE.

entries.purpose: Current and wave orbital velocity field, turbidity/visibility/acoustic heuristics, difficulty profiles, fault injection.
entries.architectural_compatibility: Airy deep-water wave relations are textbook; all other formulas invented (OpticalVisibilityMeters=32/(1+0.75*NTU+5*c)).
entries.dependency_contamination: Mathf.PerlinNoise, RenderSettings globals, Time.time; YAML self-labelled 'simulator hypotheses, not measured ocean constants'.
entries.test_quality: Monotonicity tests only (wave decay with depth, contamination reduces visibility).
entries.reason: Twin1 component with invented environment coefficients; reimplement waves from a cited reference if needed.

entries.purpose: Noisy sensor emulation and synthetic frame capture with provenance sidecar.

entries.dependency_contamination: SensorNoise.Gaussian uses process-global unseeded UnityEngine.Random.value; invented DVL quality 1-0.35*d/max.
entries.reason: Global RNG, invented noise figures, no frames or ns timebase; synthetic-labelling idea already a V2 rule.
